args: Option C of the row-flyout-card legibility work: elevate the hover card onto bg-bg-card with a theme-aware shadow (bg-bg-primary is the same hex as the terminal behind it, and stock shadow-lg is invisible on dark), promote action-row labels to text-text-primary with full-contrast hints (opacity-60 hints measure 2.5:1, under AA), and give the action list its own bg-bg-inset tray with a two-color hover rail — accent-green for Change color / Fork / Pin, signal-red for Kill window.
